overall_goal: Cook frozen broccoli and green beans in the air fryer

goals.description: Retrieve frozen vegetables and place them on the counter
goals.rationale: The person retrieves the frozen vegetables from the freezer and places them on the kitchen counter to prepare for cooking.

goals.description: Set up and preheat the air fryer
goals.rationale: The person takes the air fryer out of the cabinet, plugs it in, and turns it on to preheat.

goals.description: Transfer the first batch of vegetables to the air fryer
goals.rationale: The person transfers the first batch of weighed vegetables into the air fryer to start cooking them.

goals.description: Weigh and add the frozen broccoli to the air fryer
goals.rationale: The person weighs the frozen broccoli using a bowl and a kitchen scale, then adds it to the air fryer.

goals.description: Shake and mix the vegetables during cooking
goals.rationale: The person periodically opens the air fryer to shake and mix the vegetables to ensure even cooking.
